item.title: California’s Instant EV Rebates Would Require Automakers to Match State Funds
item.description: New budget language lays out how Gov. Gavin Newsom plans to structure a $200 million electric vehicle rebate program, including price caps, automaker matching funds and a focus on first-time buyers.

item.title: Bay Area Buzzes With Fans, Parties and Pageantry on Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: Tens of thousands of fans flooded Santa Clara and San Francisco for Super Bowl LX, turning streets around Levi’s Stadium into a lively fan festival filled with tailgate parties, team colors and anticipation for Bad Bunny’s halftime show.

item.title: San José Mayor Matt Mahan Wants to Be Governor. Here’s a Look Into His Signature Homelessness Program
item.description: Since taking office in 2023, Mahan has dramatically shifted the city’s approach to homelessness from building permanent affordable housing to building temporary shelters.

item.title: Is It Crow-maggedon? Why Crows Are Flocking to Bay Area Cities Each Winter
item.description: Have you seen the huge gatherings of crows near Oakland’s Lake Merritt or in downtown San Francisco? There’s an explanation for their behavior.

item.title: SF Teachers Walk Out in First Strike in Nearly 50 Years. Schools Will Remain Closed
item.description: The city’s 111 public school campuses are closed Monday and will stay closed Tuesday after the San Francisco Unified School District and the teachers union failed to come to a contract deal.

item.title: 7 People Shot in Downtown San José on Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: Two people were killed and five others injured in two separate shootings on Sunday in downtown San José, police said.

item.title: Bay Area Latino Community Celebrates Bad Bunny Halftime Show
item.description: Bad Bunny paid homage to his home of Puerto Rico.

item.title: San Leandro City Council Member Accused of Corruption to Retire on Eve of Court Hearing
item.description: San Leandro City Councilmember Bryan Azevedo was charged in October in connection with an ongoing federal corruption investigation that also ensnared former Oakland Mayor Sheng Thao.

item.title: San Francisco Parents Scramble for Child Care Amid Teachers’ Strike
item.description: In San Francisco’s Excelsior neighborhood, the nonprofit Mission Science Workshop opened its doors to provide activities for families.

item.title: After US Judge Blocks California’s ICE Mask Ban, Scott Wiener Says He Will Make It Enforceable
item.description: While a partial win for the Trump administration, the court left room for California to make the mask ban constitutional.
